government_groups_citation.claim: Most's 2022-2026 governing coalition, formed after the Oct 2022 election, is ProMOST (won the election, 21/45 seats, 41% of the vote) + ANO 2011 (2nd place, 10/45 seats, 20%) — 31/45 seats, a clear majority. Jan Paparega (ProMOST) was initially mayor; he resigned within months of also being elected senator, and Marek Hrvol (ProMOST, former first deputy mayor) became mayor on 2023-01-01, reportedly the youngest mayor in the Czech Republic at the time. ProMOST holds the mayor and both deputy mayor posts plus 3 more council seats; ANO's 3 council seats include their 2022 election leader Ivana Hvezdova.

Corroborated directly by the source feed's own `koalice` field (zastupitelstva[0].koalice), which is NOT currently read/used anywhere in standardize.py or party_affiliation.py but independently states the coalition as idPolitickeSubjekt [3, 1] = ProMOST + ANO 2011, for one single unbroken interval spanning the ENTIRE term recorded so far (2022-10-24 to 2026-06-18, the dataset's last observed session) — i.e. the source's own data agrees with the news citation above, and shows no coalition change/reshuffle across the whole term.
sources: most/work/raw/zastupko_dataset_8.json's own zastupitelstva[0].koalice field — internal source-data citation, not an external news claim

government_groups_citation.claim: The feed's own `lidr` (mayor) field is UNRELIABLE here, same caveat already documented for Brno's wpca_definition.json: it names idZastupitel=4 (Renata Cisarova, an SPD s pod.Trik. councilor, definitely NOT the mayor) rather than the real mayor. Do not use the `lidr` field as a mayor/rotate-anchor source for this city; the news citations above (Marek Hrvol, ProMOST, source id 17) are the trustworthy source instead.
sources: most/work/raw/zastupko_dataset_8.json's own zastupitelstva[0].lidr field (internal, shown here as a documented DATA QUALITY CAVEAT, not a claim to rely on)
